lines.zh: 我一步一步走过来，关节在响
lines.en: I come step by step, my joints creaking

lines.zh: 铁皮包着身子，走路很响
lines.en: Iron plates wrapped around me make every step loud

lines.zh: 不到三格高，穿门还是得弯
lines.en: Under three blocks tall, and I still stoop through doors
I do not run, I walk

lines.zh: 地面被我的脚压出印子
lines.en: My feet press marks into the ground

lines.zh: 粗胳膊甩着，擦到墙就掉灰
lines.en: My thick arms swing and knock dust off walls

lines.zh: 装出来的身子，步伐很稳
lines.en: A built body, and my gait is steady
Wind on iron makes a dull sound
I walk one direction and do not turn
The footsteps arrive before I do

lines.zh: 每走一步，膝盖都卡一下
lines.en: Each step, my knee catches once

lines.zh: 我不觉得累，这身子不会累
lines.en: I do not tire, this body cannot tire

lines.zh: 我站着，铁皮上的光很冷
lines.en: I stand and the light on my plates is cold
Something grinds inside my joint
I turn my head, my neck lags behind

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一件铁器
lines.en: I stand like a piece of ironwork
The eyes in my head do not blink

lines.zh: 远处的声音我听得一清二楚
lines.en: I hear every distant sound clearly
I do not breathe, my chest does not rise
Wind passes through the seams in my plating
I raise a hand and a bolt comes loose
I clench my fist and let it open

lines.zh: 我的影子在一面墙上一动不动
lines.en: My shadow sits motionless on a wall

lines.zh: 站久了，脚底的草被压死
lines.en: Standing long, the grass under my feet dies

lines.zh: 这一带没什么值得砸的
lines.en: There is little here worth smashing
I remember the face of the one who built me
You come up about to my knee
I look down and my neck clicks
Those bones of yours would break easily

lines.zh: 我不需要理由就能动手
lines.en: I need no reason to move

lines.zh: 你的心跳我听得见，很快
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat, it is fast
I raise a hand and my shadow covers you
Standing in front of me is brave

lines.zh: 这双眼睛不识人，只识目标
lines.en: These eyes do not read people, only targets
Why are you looking at my joints
I bend down and bring my face close
Your armor is leather

lines.zh: 我见过很多像你这样的
lines.en: I have seen many like you
Do not back away, there is a wall behind you

lines.zh: 我能听见你的膝盖在抖
lines.en: I can hear your knees trembling
One punch would settle your size

lines.zh: 我站着，突然就记起了你的脸
lines.en: I stand, and I suddenly remember your face
If you mean to run, run now

lines.zh: 我没有表情，所以你看不出我在想什么
lines.en: I have no expression, so you cannot tell what I am thinking

lines.zh: 铁皮凹了，里面的东西没坏
lines.en: The plate dented, nothing inside broke

lines.zh: 我没出声，出声也没意义
lines.en: I made no sound, it would mean nothing

lines.zh: 这一下，造我的人会不高兴
lines.en: My maker would not like that

lines.zh: 我低头看凹处，慢慢抬头
lines.en: I look at the dent and slowly lift my head
A bolt has come loose
My movement slowed by half a beat
Something inside is rattling
Your strength is insufficient
I take half a step back and steady
Noted, you will be dealt with

lines.zh: 你把东西举到一个铁人面前
lines.en: You hold that up to an iron man
I glance at it, I have no appetite
I do not eat, and do not need to
Hold it long enough and your arm will ache
This body runs on something else
Put it back, stop holding it up

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，你差点摔
lines.en: I put up a hand and you nearly fell

lines.zh: 我弯下腰看，看得你不自在
lines.en: I bend to look, and it makes you uneasy

lines.zh: 你把它给一个造物，是浪费
lines.en: Giving that to a construct is a waste

lines.zh: 你撞在铁上，弹回去的是你
lines.en: You hit iron, and you are the one thrown back
I did not move, the ground did
Keep clear of my legs

lines.zh: 这一下，你的肩膀记住了
lines.en: That one, your shoulder will remember
I put a hand out and steady you
What you hit was my bracer
Iron against flesh, the result is not in question

lines.zh: 我退了一步，膝盖卡了一下
lines.en: I take a step back and my knee catches
Not from behind my back
Bump me again and I will not steady you

lines.zh: 我是造出来的，没有亲族
lines.en: I was made, I have no kin
I do not understand that kind of talk

lines.zh: 造我的人没有给我这个
lines.en: My maker did not give me that
I only stand, walk, and strike
Do not put your hand on my plating
I have no heartbeat to give you
What you say does not stay with me

lines.zh: 我低头看你，然后什么也没说
lines.en: I look down at you and say nothing
Standing here has gone on long enough
I bend and my knee cracks

lines.zh: 手指太粗，夹不住小东西
lines.en: My fingers are too thick for small things

lines.zh: 我捡起来了，东西捏扁了
lines.en: I pick it up and it is dented

lines.zh: 这个放哪儿？我没有口袋
lines.en: Where does this go? I have no pockets

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西不归我
lines.en: What lies on the ground is not mine

lines.zh: 我举到眼前，眼睛不会看细节
lines.en: I hold it to my eyes, they do not see detail

lines.zh: 这东西很轻，对我不算什么
lines.en: This is light, nothing to me
I squeeze once and it crumbles
Iron hands have no sense of pressure
I set it back down, forget it

lines.zh: 你被造我的那个人点了名
lines.en: The one who made me named you
I raise my hand and point one way
I am coming for you, do not block the way
This body exists for this
Every step under me rings out

lines.zh: 你已经在我前面了，很好
lines.en: You are ahead of me, good
I have no feeling, only an objective
I have your scent recorded

lines.zh: 我低头看你，眼睛亮了一下
lines.en: I look down at you and my eyes brighten
Run, and I follow
The iron fist is already clenched
This space is too narrow, bad for you
I come step by step, no rush
Look back and you are done
When I stand still, I am aiming
The order was one line, take you down
I follow you, in no hurry

lines.zh: 你拐进小巷，我进不去，就撞墙
lines.en: You duck into an alley, so I break the wall
The door is too low, I stoop through

lines.zh: 你的脚步在楼梯上很响
lines.en: Your steps on the stairs are loud
I put a hand out and shove the fence down

lines.zh: 你换了几次方向，我都看着
lines.en: You changed direction several times, all noted
I do not shout, it would ruin the voice
These plates will stop arrows
You grow tired, I do not
I am calculating where you will land
Hiding behind the door will not help, it is flimsy

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下去，地板裂了
lines.en: I plant a foot and the floor splits

lines.zh: 你的位置一直没跳出我的视线
lines.en: You have not left my sight

lines.zh: 我慢慢逼近，每一步都一样长
lines.en: I close in with identical strides
Your breathing is getting rough
There is no other door around here
I wait for you to stop on your own

lines.zh: 再过一会儿，距离就变了
lines.en: In a moment the distance changes

lines.zh: 一拳砸下去，墙塌了半边
lines.en: One punch and half the wall collapses
I grab your waist and lift

lines.zh: 手掌拍在你背上，声音很闷
lines.en: My palm slaps your back with a dull sound
A knee comes up and you fold
This stomp shatters the ground

lines.zh: 你挡住了手臂，可挡不住力
lines.en: You blocked the arm, not the force

lines.zh: 我扔出去的时候没使全力
lines.en: I did not throw you at full strength

lines.zh: 我抬手，把门框都撞掉了
lines.en: I raise my hand and knock out the door frame
That sends you two blocks

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩膀，按下去
lines.en: I take your shoulder and press down
Your bones held, luckily

lines.zh: 我的关节卡了一下，你趁机退了
lines.en: My joint caught and you slipped back
The second punch lands harder
You are standing again

lines.zh: 这一招，是造我的人教的
lines.en: This move was taught by my maker
Iron lands and crushes out a crater

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，先露肩膀
lines.en: I come from behind the trees, shoulders first

lines.zh: 地面晃了一下，我就站在那儿
lines.en: The ground shook, and I was standing there
The smell of rust hangs on me
I raise my head, higher than the trees
Someone far off turned to look

lines.zh: 关节一动，声音传得很远
lines.en: One joint moves and the sound carries
I did not crouch when I landed
I was ordered to come here
I brush the dirt off my shoulder
I rise slowly to my full height
The light on my plating is harsh
The wind makes the seams whistle
I settle and take a look around
The tree under my foot snapped
I am here, so the order is complete

lines.zh: 铁靴踩在土上，留下深印
lines.en: My iron boots leave deep prints
I lift a foot and the door frame cracks

lines.zh: 火烧得铁皮发烫，我在冒烟
lines.en: Fire heats the plates and I am smoking

lines.zh: 我落地的声音比平时大
lines.en: My landing was louder than usual
Iron is heavy, I am going under
The blast knocked half my face askew
An arrow is stuck in a seam

lines.zh: 那股力气钻进了我体内
lines.en: That force has gotten inside me

lines.zh: 我没有饥饿，可动力在降
lines.en: I do not hunger, but my power is falling

lines.zh: 雷打在铁皮上，我停了一瞬
lines.en: Lightning struck my plating and I froze for a moment

lines.zh: 铁身太重，虚空拉我下去
lines.en: This iron body is heavy, the void pulls me down
